introduction: Washington ESD reviews unemployment applications and eligibility for each claimed week. Benefits are not based on financial need.
description: Washington ESD reviews unemployment applications and eligibility for each claimed week. Benefits are not based on financial need.

sections.who: ESD checks covered work hours, job separation and ability and availability to work. Its basic rules require at least 680 base-year hours.
sections.get: Approved weekly payments depend on the claim. Each week needs a separate certification.
sections.docs:

  • Employer and work history for the last 18 months.
  • Requested work-authorization and payment details.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Sign into eServices using SecureAccess Washington, or call 800-318-6022.

  2. Answer questions

    Provide complete separation details and respond to requests.

  3. Claim each week

    Report work and earnings and follow job-search requirements.
sections.after: Keep a job-search record. The current rule generally requires three activities each claimed week unless ESD instructs otherwise.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using ESD eligibility; Application information; Weekly claims; Contact and intake. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is approval based on low income?
No. Unemployment uses employment and weekly eligibility rules.
What does a claim issue mean?
ESD may need further information before deciding eligibility.
